Name: Stardew Fatty
Author: BraceforImpasse
Description:
[b]STARDEW VALLEY v1.4 MOD FOR WINDOWS.[/b]

Last updated 2019/11/27. If you run into any issues, please contact me here or on [url=http://www.deviantart.com/notahugesecret]DeviantArt[/url]﻿. Previous versions of Stardew Fatty can also be found there.

Want the Content Patcher version instead? Click [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4682]HERE[/url].

Install Stardew Fatty to instantly change your Stardew Valley experience.

NOW FEATURING:
[b]Ample Abigail[/b]: New portraits, new overworld sprites, new and edited dialogue, edited scenes.
[b]Heavy Haley[/b]: New portraits, new overworld sprites, new and edited dialogue, edited scenes.
[b]Larger Leah[/b]: New portraits, new overworld sprites, new and edited dialogue, edited scenes.
[b]Cherubic Maru[/b]: New color-corrected portraits, new and edited dialogue.
[b]Eager Emily[/b]: New and edited dialogue, edited scenes.
[b]Supersize Sebastian[/b]: New portraits, new overworld sprites, new and edited dialogue, edited scenes.
And (slightly) more!

(Please note, this mod does not touch the game code. This means visual changes are static. This mod is compatible with multiplayer.)
